If your sofa bed has reversible cushions, rotate and flip them regularly to distribute wear evenly and prevent one side from wearing out faster than the other.

Protect from direct sunlight:
Position the sofa bed away from sunlight or use curtains/blinds to prevent the fading and discolouration that is caused by prolonged exposure to sunlight.
